description: Upload a zipped .app iOS simulator build to a project from a path on this machine. The archive is hashed and streamed from disk; returns the stored artifact, whose digest muggle-remote-ios-run-create takes.

appZipPath.description: Absolute path on this machine of the zipped .app simulator build (.zip, at most 512 MB). Streamed from disk; never read it yourself.

branch.description: Git branch the build was made from

bundleId.description: The app's bundle identifier, e.g. com.example.app

commit.description: Git commit SHA the build was made from

producer.description: Who is uploading: ci_push for an automated pipeline or agent (default); dashboard_upload only for a person's manual upload

projectId.description: Muggle project ID (UUID) the iOS build or run belongs to

targetRuntime.description: Simulator runtime the build targets, e.g. iOS-17-5

name: muggle-remote-ios-build-upload
